name: cz-fakan-os
description: acii_os packaged as a native iOS app (cz.fakan.os) via Capacitor. The web stays zero-dependency, no-build vanilla ES modules; Capacitor is only a native wrapper.

scripts.copy: npm run build && npx cap copy ios && node tools/ios-postsync.mjs
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && node tools/ios-postsync.mjs
